units.translation: For thus Hermann corrected it for ὁρμαίνει [he rushes], comparing Hesychius' gloss ὀρυγάνει: ἐρεύγεται [oruganei: he belches]. The usual form is ἐρυγγάνω [I belch], for which Aeschylus said ὀρυγάνω [I belch], just as θηγάνω [I sharpen] for θήγω [I sharpen], which itself is also not found in other authors.
Thus he belches forth his own spirit as he falls.
